title: Optunia Rufida - 1x Mini Plug - Prickly Pear - Easy Care Fast Growing Cactus 🌵
description: The Optunia Rufida mini plug plant is a fast-growing cactus in the genus Opuntia, perfect for indoors in arid climates. Let this prickly pear plant thrive in full sun with light watering, making it easy to care for. This indoor plant is ideal for any room and comes in a pot, ready to bring a touch of greenery to your living space. Enjoy its unique features and be cautious of its thorns as you watch it flourish in springtime. Made in the United Kingdom by Cactus, this decorative plant is sure to add character to your home.
